readings.summary: Barkley funds half the markdown if we guarantee a top-3 banner and the range sells a very high target.

terms.quote: We can fund 50% of the markdown on the Barkley range, provided you guarantee a top-3 banner and the range sells 3,400 units between 6th and 12th Nov.

readings.summary: Purrline funds a flat share of the markdown on every promoted SKU.

terms.quote: Purrline will fund 30% of the markdown on every Purrline SKU you put on promo.

readings.summary: NutriPaws supports a share of the discount if the range reaches a sales target.

terms.quote: NutriPaws can support 35% of the discount cost across our range if the range sells 1,150 units during 6-12 Nov.

readings.summary: Litterly will not fund any discount this quarter.
Groomwell funds a share on two hero SKUs in return for a top-3 banner.

terms.quote: Groomwell will fund 25% of the markdown on GW-01 and GW-03 for the Festive Sale if you give us a top-3 banner placement.

readings.summary: Tailwind funds a share on two SKUs and cannot restock before the sale.

terms.quote: We can fund 40% of the markdown on TW-01 and TW-02.
